ev.q: By December 2021, 16 (34%) countries achieved ≥90% HepB3 coverage
only two (4%) achieved ≥90% timely HepB-BD coverage
By December 2021, 16 (34%) countries achieved ≥90% HepB3 coverage
Regional HepB-BD coverage increased from 10% in 2016 to 17% in 2021.
Eighteen (38%) countries reached ≥90% HepB3 coverage in 2016; this number peaked at 20 (43%) in 2018
This report describes progress made during 2016–2021 to achieve hepatitis B control
During this period, regional HepB3 coverage ranged from 75% in 2019 to 71% in 2021.

methods_quotes.q: The coverage is calculated by dividing the total number of doses administered by the estimated target population for vaccination.
Timely receipt of HepB-BD is defined as administration of 1 dose of HepB within 24 hours of birth.
Population-based surveys including the Population based HIV Impact Assessment (PHIA) surveys and Demographic Health Survey (DHS) were also used.
